metaDescription: Make is a visual automation platform for connecting apps and building multi-step workflows and AI agents. See its features, credit-based Free, Core, Pro, Teams and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Make, formerly Integromat, is a visual automation platform. You connect apps and build multi-step workflows, called scenarios, on a drag-and-drop canvas, with routing, filters, data transformation and live execution logs.

Make connects to more than 3,000 apps and includes AI modules and Make AI Agents for autonomous tasks; paid plans can also use your own AI provider. Pricing is based on credits: most module actions use one credit, while some features, such as built-in AI tools, can use more. A free plan with 1,000 credits a month has no time limit.

features.title: Visual Scenario Builder
features.text: Build multi-step workflows on a drag-and-drop canvas, with routes and filters.

features.title: 3,000+ app integrations
features.text: Connect a large catalogue of apps in your scenarios.

features.title: AI agents and modules
features.text: Make AI Agents and AI modules, using Make's AI provider or your own on paid plans.

features.title: Scheduling
features.text: Run scenarios on a schedule, down to the minute on paid plans.

features.title: Execution logs
features.text: See each run in detail, with full-text log search on the Pro plan.

features.title: Teams and API
features.text: Shared team workspaces and roles on Teams, plus the Make API on paid plans.

useCases: Operations automation for small and mid-sized teams
strengths: A visual builder that makes complex, multi-step workflows easier to follow.
A free plan with 1,000 credits a month and no time limit.
Paid plans start low for 10,000 credits a month.
limitations: Credits can run out faster when scenarios use AI tools or process lots of data.
The free plan is limited to 1,000 credits a month.
Priority execution and full-text log search need the Pro plan.
Shared team development needs the Teams plan.
Credit-based pricing needs monitoring at higher volumes.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Paid plans are priced by monthly credit volume. Make's pricing page lists Core from $9/mo; Make's recent articles list the monthly-billing prices below, for 10,000 credits a month. Paying yearly in advance is cheaper.
